title: 第5章 巨腾集团
content_zh:
场中虽是两人比武，但可看的却只一人。曹虎来来去去这十几招，大家委实都瞧得厌了。岳胜的拳招却变幻百出，花式似乎无穷无尽。一套燕青拳奈何不了对方，忽然拳法又变，使出一套鲁智深醉跌。但见他如疯如癫，似醉似狂，忽而卧倒，忽而跃起，“罗汉斜卧”、“仙人渴盹”，这路拳法似是瞎打乱踢，其实精彩之极。这时曹虎那十几招笨拳却渐渐不管事了，对方拳脚来路也看不明白，不由心下着慌。猛听岳胜喝声：“着！”一脚“鲤鱼翻身搅丝腿”正好踢在他腰间。曹虎痛得弯下了腰。

    岳胜知对方功夫了得，这脚虽中要害，只怕仍难令他身受重伤。倘若平常比武较量，胜了这腿自也可以收手，但这番争斗关系三百万货物，怎容敌人喘息片刻？若是争端重起，也未必定能再胜，当下得理不让人，纵身上前，一腿拐子脚又往他后心踢去。

    群盗齐声大哗。曹虎忽然一脚钩腿反踢，来势变幻无方，岳胜虽阅历丰富，竟见不及此，给他这腿踢中小腹，仰天一跤直摔出去。岳青与周银兵双双抢上扶起。但见他面如白纸，连声咳嗽，只说：“拼死护货！”

    群盗人多，除曹虎外虽无高手，但岳青与周银兵要分心照料岳胜，给群盗两下里一攻，情势登见危急。温文新拔出单刀，叫道：“三位警官，咱们动手吧！”田星辰说：“好，赶走强盗再说。”四个生力军加入战团。

    温文新见岳青给两名盗伙用武器封住了，渐渐施展不开手脚，当即抢上，喝道：“男子汉欺负姑娘，还要两个打一个，不害臊么？”唰的一刀，往那高个盗伙头上砍去。那人挥鞭招架，几个回合，温文新刀中夹掌，左手一掌抹在他胸口，将他击得直掼出去。岳青喘息说：“行了，这一个让我来料理。”温文新一笑退开，去帮助周银兵，三刀两掌，又打发了一名盗伙。周银兵感激之余，很钦佩干爸眼光，这位少堡主的武功果然远胜自己。

    这么一来，厅上情势变换，群盗纷纷败退，抢着往门口奔出。猛听一人清声长啸，叫道：“大家住手！我有话说。”众人斗得正紧，没人理会。温文新突见人影一晃，一人伸掌在面前摇动，当即举刀削去，那人右手一钩一带，已将他单刀夺过往地下摔落。温文新大惊，急忙跃后，瞧那人时，却是那服饰华贵的男子。

    那男子大踏步走入人丛，双手钩拿拍打，只听叮叮当当响声不绝，武器落了一地，都让他施展小擒拿手法夺过抛落。群盗与物流师傅们惊骇之下各自跃开，呆呆望着他。曹虎一愕，忽然记起了十余年前之事，叫道：“李董！是你？”那男子想不起他是谁，好奇问：“你认得我？”曹虎笑着说：“十三年前在天竺山，小的服侍过您。”那男子低头一想，恍然记起，说道：“是了，你是那个医生！怎么学了一身武功，做起寨主来啦？”曹虎上前请了个安说：“多谢您栽培。”

    这男子正是巨腾集团董事长李丰粮。

    李丰粮双目自左至右在众人脸上缓缓扫过，然后又自右至左地横扫过来，再向天井中倾盆而下的大雨望了一眼，眼光终于停在货车上，说道：“老曹，今天的买卖你可是赔定啦。”曹虎陪笑说：“您别见怪，也是弟兄们少口饭吃，走投无路，这才干起这没本钱买卖来。我们改过自新，不敢忘了李董的恩德。”李丰粮哈哈大笑说：“怎么跟我闹起虚文来啦？老曹，你拿五十万走，够不够使了？”曹虎一怔，陪笑说：“您老人家开玩笑啦。”李丰粮说：“开什么玩笑？这里三百万，我拿一半一百五十万，余下的你拿五十万，还有一百万你说怎么分？”

    曹虎喜出望外，忙说：“您老人家一并随手带去就是了，还分什么？”李丰粮摇头说：“那不成话，这哪里还有江湖义气？适才我们进来避雨，我……我……我夫人衣服湿了……”那美妇听他说“我夫人”三字，脸上一红，神态微现忸怩，向李丰粮微微一笑。李丰粮报以一笑，继续说：“海安物流这位姑娘借衣服给她，这番情分不能不报，咱们给岳姑娘留五十万。还有，三位警官在此，见者有份，每人分十万两。余下二十万，就送给此间主人。你说我这样分法公不公道？”曹虎连连鼓掌，大叫：“公道之极，公道之极！我早说李董是天下第一等慷慨豪爽的大英雄。”

    岳胜、周银兵、岳青等听李丰粮侃侃而谈，旁若无人，倒似这三百万货物已是他囊中之物一般。岳胜身受重伤，这么一气，更险欲晕去。周银兵连问：“怎么办？怎么办？”岳青怒道：“什么怎么办！”弯腰拾起地下单刀，叫道：“姓李的，你当我们是死人吗！”说着扬起单刀，径往李丰粮扑去。

    李丰粮笑着说：“你别逼我动手，我夫人可要喝醋的。”那美妇啐了一口，笑骂：“贫嘴！”但似对他轻薄口吻甚为喜爱。岳青听他言语无礼，更是恼怒，上步一刀，拦腰横砍。李丰粮笑着说：“哎哟，不好，我夫人可不许我跟女人打架。”手指在她刀背上一击，岳青拿捏不住，脱手撤刀。李丰粮手法快极，右手抢过刀柄，左手已拿住她手腕，举起刀来，作势要往她头颈中砍下，口中却叹道：“似这般羞花闭月貌，怎叫我不做惜玉怜香人！”

    温文新和周银兵见他戏弄岳青，双双抢出。温文新右手一扬，一枝金钱镖取他左身。周银兵急了，来不及拾取地下武器，飞脚就踢他后心。李丰粮倏地回身，撤刀擒拿，抓住他足踝，往上一提。周银兵身子倒转，只感腿上一阵剧痛，失声大叫，却是那枝金钱镖打进了他右腿。李丰粮挥手抖出，周银兵的身子犹如一柄扫帚般横扫出去，正撞在岳青腿上，两人跌在一起。众人见他戏耍二人，如弄婴儿，哪里还敢上前？

    李丰粮说：“老曹，你把货物就照我说的那么分了，匀辆车给我，我们两口子身有急事，得冒雨赶路。”曹虎大喜，连声答应。群盗从货车中取出货物，一半一百五十万堆成一大堆，此外五十万的堆了两堆，三堆十万的、一堆二十万的，分别堆在地下，向司机喝道：“乖乖赶路吧！”

    北道上有规矩，绿林豪客劫货抢银，却不伤害司机，甚至跑腿费和伙食费也依常例照给，但若司机不听嘱咐，自然又作别论。司机们见了这等情势，哪敢不依，将一百五十万货物装上了车子，冒着大雨，将货车一辆辆运出去。

    岳胜见货车出去一辆，心里就发一阵疼，只见一辆货车赶到厅前，司机开了车门，李丰粮扶着美妇便要上车。只要货车一行，岳胜就身败名裂，倾家荡产，一世辛苦付于流水了。他颤巍巍站起，突然纵身叫道：“我和你拼了！”双手犹如铁钩，猛往李丰粮脸上抓去。那美妇看得害怕，吓得大声惊叫。李丰粮侧身出掌，击向他肩头。岳胜倘若未受重伤，这掌自然打他不着，但此时全身筋骨不听使唤，眼见掌到，竟然不能闪避，砰的一声飞起，向院子中跌了出去。

    猛听一人嗓子低沉，嘿嘿嘿三下冷笑。

    这三声冷笑传进厅来，李丰粮和那美妇顿时便如听见了世上最可怕的声音一般，二人面如白纸，身子发颤。李丰粮出力推那美妇背心，将那美妇推入车中，飞身而起，跨上一旁的骏马，双腿急夹，挥鞭催马快走。哪知他连连挥鞭，这高头骏马只跨出两步，突然停住，再也不能向前半尺。

    众人站在厅门口，从水帘一般的大雨中望出去。只见一个高大瘦削的大汉，背上背着一个小女孩，左手轻轻扯住骏马的后缰，右手牢牢按住那辆车。那匹骏马给李丰粮催得急了，低头弓腰，四蹄一起发劲。司机也在拼命开车。但大汉拉着骏马、按着车后，骏马和车竟似钉牢在地下一般，动也不动。

    那大汉冷笑一声。李丰粮尚自迟疑，车中美妇已跨出车来，向那大汉瞧也不瞧，昂然走进厅去。李丰粮慢慢下车，也跟着进厅。他全身给雨淋得湿透，却似丝毫不觉，目光呆滞，失魂落魄一般。那美妇招手叫他过去，坐在她身边。

    那大汉大踏步进厅，坐在火堆旁，向旁人一眼不瞧，将背上的女孩轻轻放下。那女孩约莫五六岁年纪，双颊通红，闭着双眼。那大汉怕冷坏了女孩，抱着她在火边烤火。那女孩正自沉沉熟睡，脸色白里透红，甚是可爱，长长的睫毛旁却挂着两颗泪珠。

    岳青、周银兵和温文新三人扶着岳胜起来，见李丰粮对那大汉如此害怕，都是又惊又喜。岳青问：“爸爸，你伤处还好么？这……这人是谁？”岳胜说：“他……他就是……射……射阳名……侠……射阳名侠秦英豪……”一句话刚说完，已痛得晕了过去。大厅上，海安物流的师傅们集在东首，曹虎与群盗集在西首，三警员与温文新站在椅子后，各人目光都瞧着秦英豪、李丰粮与美妇三人。

    秦英豪凝视怀中的女孩，脸上爱怜横溢，充满着慈爱和柔情，众人若不是适才见到他一手抓住大车，一手扯住骏马，端得神力惊人，真难相信此人身负绝世武功。

    那美妇神态自若，呆呆望着火堆，嘴角边挂着一丝冷笑，只有极细心之人，才见到她嘴唇微微颤动，显得心里甚为不安。

    李丰粮脸如白纸，望着院子中的大雨。

    三个人的目光瞧着三处，谁也不瞧谁一眼，各自安安静静坐着，一言不发。但三人心中，却如波涛汹涌，有大哀伤，有大决心，也有大恐惧。
content_en:
Min Jiageng didn't have time to elaborate, so he jumped across the pond with her in his arms and was about to find a way to run out. Suddenly he heard the wind in his clothes behind him, and two people ran over and asked, "Who is he?" Min Jiageng ran forward, and the two men also rushed after her.

Min Jiageng was running very fast and suddenly stopped.The two people didn't expect him to stop suddenly, and rushed past him.Min Jiageng jumped into the air, his legs flew together, and the toes of his two feet simultaneously kicked the "Shentang point" on the vests of the two men.The two of them fell to the ground without even making a sound.Judging from the clothes of these two people, they are the guards guarding outside the water pavilion.

Min Jiageng thought that now his traces were exposed, and he rushed out of the house without any thought of covering up.But hearing the calls coming one after another in the mansion, the guards shouted: "There are assassins, there are assassins!"

When he came in, he paid attention along the road and recognized the route. He still ran from the cobblestone flower path to the small door, climbed over the white wall, and the car was still waiting outside the door.He put Yue Qing into the car and shouted: "Go back." The driver had already heard the noise in the house and saw that Min Jiageng had a strange look on his face. When he wanted to ask for more information, Min Jiageng had already reached out to knock him down and stuff him into the back seat.

At this moment, four or five guards were chasing him. Min Jiageng drove off and ran away. Several guards chased him for more than ten feet and failed to catch up. They shouted: "Bring the horse, bring the horse!"

Min Jiageng galloped his horse and ran out of several streets, but when he heard the rapid sound of hoofbeats, more than 20 horsemen were chasing after him.The pursuers were all riding good horses, and they were getting closer and closer.Min Jiageng was secretly anxious: "This is the Vikings, which is unusual. If there is another disturbance, city guards will be dispatched to round up her. Even if I can escape, how can I save Sister Qing?"

In the darkness, he saw that the people chasing him were holding torches. Yue Qing in the car had moaned at first, but now it was silent. Min Jiageng was so worried that he asked: "Is the stomachache better?" After several questions, Yue Qing did not answer.When he turned around, the torch was shining, and the pursuers were getting closer.Suddenly he heard a whooshing sound, and someone threw a locust stone and hit him in the back of the heart.Min Jiageng caught it with his left hand and threw it back, but he heard someone shout "Ah yo" and fell off his horse.

This reminded Min Jiageng that it was best to fire concealed weapons to repel the pursuers, but he did not carry any concealed weapons with him, and the pursuing guards learned their lesson and stopped firing concealed weapons.He was so anxious: "It's still a long way back to Weiyuan Gate. There are a lot of people yelling in the middle of the night. Why don't you alert the patrol?" He suddenly remembered the golden pot in his arms. He stretched out his hand and squeezed the chair shawl several times. The gems inlaid on the golden pot suddenly melted.After eight or nine stones fell, he took the gems in his hand and saw them clearly under the light of the torch. He raised his right hand and the gems flew out one by one. Eight gems hit five guards. Although the gems were small, Min Jiageng's hand was strong and hit the head, face and eyes, causing great pain.In this way, the guards would not dare to get too close.

Min Jiageng took a long breath and stretched out his hand to feel Yue Qing's breath. Fortunately, she was still breathing. He heard her moan softly, but her cheeks were very cold. Seeing that she was not far from her residence, she whipped her whip and galloped to a fork in the road.His residence was in the east, but he drove the car to the west, turned a corner, turned around, picked up Yue Qing, relieved the driver's acupoints, and ordered him to drive westward, and the guards gave chase.

Min Jiageng waited for everyone to go away, then returned to the house from the roof. Just after crossing the wall, he heard Yu Sheng say: "Brother, you are back! Is anyone chasing you?" Min Jiageng said: "Sister Qing has been poisoned, let's see!" He hugged Yue Qing and rushed into the hall.

Yu Sheng saw that Yue Qing's face was ashen and bloodless, and squeezed her fingers again. Seeing that they did not bounce back after sinking, she shook her head slightly and asked, "What kind of poison was it?" Min Jiageng took out the golden pot from his arms and said, "The poison was in the ginseng soup. This is the pot for holding the ginseng soup." Yu Sheng opened the lid of the pot, sniffed it a few times, and said, "It's amazing! It's crane top red." MinJiageng asked: "Can it be saved?" Yu Sheng did not answer, but checked Yue Qing's heartbeat and said: "If he were not a rich and noble family, he would not have such a precious golden pot." Min Jiageng said bitterly: "Exactly. The person who poisoned was the wife of the former deputy cabinet minister and the mother of the current minister of the interior." Yu Sheng said: "It's amazing! There is such a wealthy person in our line of work."

Min Jiageng saw that she remained calm, as if Yue Qing was still seriously poisoned but could still be saved, so he felt a little more at ease.Yu Sheng opened Yue Qing's eyelids to take a look, and suddenly let out a low voice.Min Jiageng asked hurriedly: "How is it?" Yu Sheng said: "In addition to the red crane crown in the ginseng soup, there is also the turtle." Min Jiageng did not dare to ask "Is there any way to save it?", but asked: "How can we save it?"

Yu Sheng frowned and said, "To attack with two poisons, it will take a lot of effort." He went back into the room, took out two white pills from the medicine box, gave Yue Qing to take them, and said, "We must find a quiet and secret room, use golden needles to prick her thirteen acupoints, and the antidote will be sent from the acupoints. If the acupuncture can be applied immediately, she will be rescued. However, she is not allowed to move for twenty-four hours."

Min Jiageng said: "Many people know about this villa. The guards of Hengda Mansion will be here in a blink of an eye. You can't use needles here. You have to find a remote place." Yu Sheng said: "Then we must leave quickly. Those two pills can only prolong her life for more than two hours." He sighed and added: "My colleagueAlthough the heart is poisonous, the method of poisoning is weak.If the two poisons are mixed and mixed with ginseng soup, the toxicity will be slowed down.If used alone, how can Sister Qing still survive?" Min Jiageng hurriedly packed up the things and said, "Who else can surpass our Miss Yu's magical skills in this world?"

Yu Sheng smiled slightly and was about to answer when he suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves approaching from far away and ran outside the house.Min Jiageng drew out his single sword and said, "We have no choice but to fight." But he was secretly anxious in his heart: "The enemies will surely kill more and more. In the critical situation, I can only take care of Shengsheng, but I can't save Sister Qing." He turned to look at Yu Sheng, and his eyes said: "I will definitely save you!" Yu Sheng was also looking at him at this time, and their eyes met, as if they understood immediately.

Yu Sheng said: "In the capital, I'm afraid there will be no barbarism. Brother, you pile the tables and chairs high and build a high platform." Min Jiageng didn't know what he meant, but he thought she was very resourceful. The situation was urgent at this time and he didn't have time to ask in detail, so he stacked the tables and chairs as instructed.

Yu Sheng pointed to the big tree outside the window and said, "Take Sister Qing up the tree." Min Jiageng said, "You will come over later." He put the knife into its sheath, hugged Yue Qing, walked to the tree outside the window, jumped up the trunk, and hid Yue Qing in the darkness among the branches and leaves.

But after hearing the sound of footsteps, several guards came over the wall and gradually approached. When Butler An went out to inquire, the guards shouted sharply.Yu Sheng turned on the lamp, took out a candle, lit it, put it in the candle holder, closed the window, then closed the door and walked out, picked up a stone on the ground, jumped up the tree trunk, and sat next to Min Jiageng.Min Jiageng whispered: "There are seventeen people in total!" Yu Sheng said: "The medicine is powerful enough!"

I heard the guards searching around, and the voice of one of them was Li Yun.The guards were very afraid of Min Jiageng and thought that Yi Diandian was still in the villa. They did not dare to wander around or leave him alone, so they searched for him in groups of three and four.

Yu Sheng handed the stone to Min Jiageng and whispered: "Knock down the tables and chairs!" Min Jiageng said with a smile: "Great idea!" The stone flew in through the window and hit a table in the middle.The high platform made of tables and chairs suddenly collapsed, and the sound of ping-ping-pong-pong was heard.The guards shouted: "Here, here!" Relying on the large number of people, everyone rushed into the hall. They saw tables and chairs in a mess, as if someone had been fighting fiercely here, but no one was visible.While everyone was stunned, they suddenly felt dizzy, unsteady on their feet, and fell down together.Min Jiageng said: "The seven-leaf flower has done another wonderful job!"

Yu Sheng quietly walked into the hall, blew out the candle, put the candle in his arms, waved to Min Jiageng and said, "Let's go!" Min Jiageng picked up Yue Qing and walked out over the wall. Just as he turned out of the alley, he couldn't help but scream in pain, but he saw the street lanterns and torches in front of him shining like daylight, and teams of patrolmen were patrolling.

Min Jiageng hurriedly turned south and walked less than half a mile when a group of patrolmen came towards him.He thought to himself: "The news that there are assassins in Hengda Mansion has spread throughout the Vikings. At this time, there are strict patrols everywhere, and it is really difficult to sneak into a remote place in the countryside." There was a noise behind him, and another team of patrolmen came.Seeing enemies in front and behind, Min Jiageng signaled to Yu Sheng, jumped over the wall, and climbed into a large villa next to him.Yu Sheng jumped in.
